capabilities.description: TEST-ONLY. Merged by `tauri build --features conformance --config src-tauri/tauri.conformance.conf.json` for the separate conformance binary. Grants the in-app runner its scenario, report, capture, exit, window-lifecycle, crash-arming, simulated-fault, store-reopen and approval-withdrawal commands. `conformance_ungranted` is registered and listed in the app manifest but deliberately granted by no capability.
